tool_args.rationale: The targeted open-branch probe added one useful point, but the mixed input/gradient variation still does not identify a quantitative law robustly enough for the 0.045 tolerance. The fine trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe to distinguish candidate smooth mechanisms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth stationary law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Six observations vary both u_now and s_grad, leaving base-field curvature and gradient coupling confounded; no fresh confirmation is available yet.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the target-law ambiguity.
Observed s_grad values do not exceed the cited siphon threshold or the suggested 2.36 trigger.
